patch_list: Disables Google PairIP's license/installer check (com.pairip.licensecheck) so a re-signed build runs on a real device instead of being redirected to the Play Store and killed. No-ops the LicenseContentProvider entry point and LicenseClient…

Unlocks Investify premium — forces the backend `no_ads` entitlement getter to report true in both the model and its Realm proxy, so the app treats the account as ad-free without any purchase. Ad SDK loads are gated on this flag app-wide.
